about_the_game:
The story takes place in the Chinese nether world, where you were a chivalrous hero in your previous life. You will set sail on an ancient warship, the “Shenzhou,” navigating through the islands of the Yellow Springs. For survival, you’ve built your base on the ship. During the day, you’ll venture onto the islands to gather materials, and at night, you’ll defend and cook. On your journey, you’ll be accompanied by a talking white dog named Diting. Diting is the mythical mount of the bodhisattva Ksitigarbha. The main objective of the game is to help Diting regain his divine powers and escape from pursuit.

In the game, your character’s strength depends on what you eat each day, and the quality of your food relies on your survival skills. Your understanding of the world will deepen over time. To finally outpace death, you must delve deeper into the island’s dangers and learn from its wanderers.

Our game is still under development, and a showcase video will be added later. Current screenshots are not representative of the final product.

Unique Features:

·         Reincarnation -
Many ghosts and goblins have unique methods of reincarnation
Allowing you to choose a compassionate approach
Reincarnation not only avoids conflict
But also accumulates virtue, which has significant benefits

·         Shen (Spirit) -
Shen is one of the basic attributes of the protagonist’s “Jing-Qi-Shen.”
Physical labor and killing will deplete your Shen.
Running out of Shen will lead to the disintegration of the soul,
similar to how overworking can lead to sudden death.
It’s quite the netherworld experience.

·         Naval Cannon -
You signal from the island with a whistle,
while the dog fires the cannon from the ship,
implementing long-range fire support,
and also delivering supplies.

·         Farming - Plant soybeans, harvest soybeans.

·         Refining - Soybeans can be ground to make tofu.

·         Cooking - Tofu + Pork + Chili = Mapo Tofu.

·         Animal Husbandry - You can raise chickens for eggs and sheep for milk.
… More content awaits your discovery.

name: Underdrift: The Chinese Nether World

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: WinXP/2003/Vista/7
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 1.7GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce 8600GT / ATI HD2400
  • Storage: 4.5 GB available space

short_description: “Underdrift: The Chinese Nether World” is a survival crafting game themed on the Chinese Hundred Ghosts. Discover islands in the realm of the afterlife, defeat various ghosts, gather resources, craft Chinese cuisine and ancient technology, and embark on a naval adventure unlike any other.
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
